verdict: Coca-Cola grew revenue 7% to $13.4B on 5% volume growth, widened its operating margin to 33.4%, and raised its full-year guidance.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $0.86 a year ago; comparable EPS $0.91

kpis.label: Unit case volume
kpis.note: global volume growth in the quarter

segments.name: Concentrate operations
segments.note: Selling concentrates, syrups and beverage bases to bottlers — the asset-light core of the system, up 9% from $7,499M a year ago (10-Q disaggregation by line of business).

segments.name: Finished product operations
segments.note: Bottling and selling finished drinks itself, including fairlife and Costa ready-to-drink — up 5% from $4,956M a year ago.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative costs, including marketing investment in its brands.

opex.name: Other operating charges
opex.note: Small other operating charges in the quarter.

otherDetail: Other income of $368M: $653M of equity income from bottler stakes plus $224M of interest income, minus $354M of interest expense and $155M of other losses. Net income is the $4,009M attributable to Coca-Cola shareowners, after $47M attributable to noncontrolling interests.
oneTimers: The quarter included $192M of settlement charges and special termination benefits for a non-U.S. pension plan, recorded in items impacting comparability; comparable (non-GAAP) EPS was $0.91 versus $0.93 GAAP.
footerNote: Revenue segments are Coca-Cola's line-of-business split from its 10-Q (concentrate vs finished products), because its geographic segment table includes corporate revenue and eliminations that do not sum as standalone segments. Coca-Cola's fiscal quarter ended October 2, 2026.

takeaways.title: Volume, not just price, grew
takeaways.text: Global unit case volume rose 5% and concentrate sales rose 7%, with price/mix adding 1% — growth came mainly from selling more drinks. Sparkling soft drinks grew 5%, led by Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, up 16%.

takeaways.title: Margins widened
takeaways.text: Operating margin rose to 33.4% from 32.0% a year ago as gross profit grew 10% to $8,450M, faster than revenue. Net income attributable to shareowners rose 8% to $4,009M.

takeaways.title: Cash flow is strong year to date
takeaways.text: Year-to-date free cash flow (non-GAAP) was $11.4B on $12.5B of operating cash flow, and the company raised its full-year guidance alongside the results.
